question: Will XRP be above $1.00 on Binance at 7:59 PM EDT tonight (August 14)?

model.prompt_context:
This market resolves based on the price of XRP in USDT on the Binance spot market (XRPUSDT). The reference price is the close price of the Binance XRPUSDT 1-minute kline with open time 23:58:00 UTC on August 14, 2026 (7:58:00 PM EDT) — the last fully completed 1-minute candle as of the 7:59 PM EDT observation time. Resolves to "Yes" if that close price is strictly greater than 1.0000 USDT. Resolves to "No" if it is equal to or less than 1.0000 USDT. If the Binance API reports no kline for that minute (e.g., exchange downtime), the reference price is the close of the nearest preceding completed XRPUSDT 1-minute kline.

Data source clarification: Binance spot market, XRPUSDT pair, 1-minute klines via the official Binance API (https://api.binance.com/api/v3/klines?symbol=XRPUSDT&interval=1m&startTime=1786492680000&endTime=1786492740000)
